_comment: Perp taker fees in bps. taker_bps = base tier (no volume tier, no token/staking discount). vip_taker_bps = best published taker rate (top volume tier + max token/staking discount) - market-maker scale, a floor rather than a typical active-trader rate. The dashboard prices all history from this file.
